block.title: Wide strip pixel sprite sheet: cone eruption sequence filmstrip with wisp and slag rows on flat navy
block.positive: SNES-era 16-bit pixel art, flat colored pixel sprites with bold dark navy outlines and simple two-tone dithered shading, arranged as a wide horizontal filmstrip sheet on a completely flat deep-navy background, no scenery, no glow bleeding into the background, no text, no labels, no UI. The main band is an eight-frame eruption cycle of one MAGMA CONE turret, evenly spaced left to right: dormant basalt stack, seam-glow widening, crater lid lifting, first tangerine flare, full column of orange flame and pink-red molten shot, column thinning to smoke and sparks, cooling to dark crust with cherry cracks, back to dormant — the same cone silhouette every frame, only the state changing. Below it a shorter band of six EMBER WISP flame bodies orbiting their molten-gold cores in different lick patterns, each with a one-to-three pixel sparking tail. Bottom band a sparse row of shared effects: pink and red bright-core round shots, a lobbed lava glob with dripping tail, two falling droplets with gold trails, a gray ash puff, and a single small orange-white explosion bloom in three growth frames. Large readable pixel clusters, saturated limited palette, every sprite facing left, crisp pixel-grid edges.
